title: Editorial/Edit Graph
description: The derived graph of editorial decisions a run's planners made. Nodes are decisions (a passage selection, a spine block, a cut, a B-roll cover, a transition, a graphic, a music behavior, a grade correction, a mix window); edges are dependencies pointing at a decision's inputs. Built by library/tools/edit_graph.build_graph from pipeline_data.json - never authored, so it cannot disagree with the decisions it derives from.

node_count.description: The number of nodes. Equal to len(nodes) - a reader checks the two agree rather than trusting either.

node_id.description: Stable identity "<type>:<address>". Unique within the graph.

producer.description: The capability id whose output the node was derived from.

intent_refs.description: What the node serves - beat ids ("beat:<spine position>"). Empty when the node serves nothing yet.

evidence_refs.description: What the node rests on - measurement ids ("clip_catalog:clip_001"). Empty when the node rests on the edit structure alone.

constraints.description: The rules the node must satisfy. A constraint is declared only where the node's own data creates the obligation; violations_of checks exactly these declarations.

depends_on.description: Node ids this node depends on - its inputs. The blast radius of a change is the reverse walk.

payload.description: The node's own data: the spans, clip, type and parameters the queries read.
